stem.text: Some of the requirements of an efficient gas exchange system are a large surface area and a short diffusion distance.
What is correct about how alveoli are adapted to meet these requirements?

A.text: collagen and elastin fibres that allow the alveoli to stretch; an extracellular layer round the alveolus wall contains blood capillaries

B.text: gases dissolve in a layer of liquid to speed up diffusion; walls of alveoli are squamous epithelium

C.text: many folded interconnected alveoli; capillaries are next to alveolus wall

D.text: sac shape of alveoli formed by squamous cells; red blood cells are very close to capillary walls
